title: Excellent Design - Beautiful Piece - A Few Quality Control Issues
text:
Excellent Design - Beautiful Piece - A Few Quality Control Issues. Over the last several years industrial style furniture and accents have become more and more popular - they are a wonderful trend combining the warm tones of wood with metal mesh and iron accents. The juxtaposition makes the pieces interesting and unique.

This bar cabinet is a great example of industrial design combining black metal and iron with the cool grays of the wood. It really is a beautiful and functional piece of furniture.

Assembly is not too difficult with instructions being on par for this type of product.

This is a great cabinet for holding wine glasses and bar accessories as well as displaying objects on the top.

The one issue I found during assembly relates to quality control. As with most similar furniture products of this type it is constructed of laminated boards. Several of the boards that make up the cabinet were separating from the outer laminate and a few of the corners had damage. This is a combination of lack of quality control and inadequate packing materials for shipping. I was able to repair some of these flaws but not all. See photos.

While I wish I could give this product 5 stars, due to the issues mentioned above and the amount of repair work I had to preform prior to assembly, I must only give it 3 stars.
